editorial.assessment: Liberty Accounts is a UK charity-accounting and payroll product with explicit church workflows, rather than a complete church-management system. It is particularly relevant where a church needs charity finance capabilities including funds, Gift Aid, GASDS and formal reporting, with Church of England Return of Parish Finance support. It should be assessed alongside the church's independent accounting advice, existing payment tools and controls for donor and payroll data.
bestFor: Churches prioritising UK charity fund accounting and formal financial reports
Anglican parishes needing a Return of Parish Finance workflow
Treasurers needing Gift Aid, GASDS and a donor ledger within an accounting system
strengths: Published charity and church accounting scope
Fund accounting, donor ledger, Gift Aid, GASDS and SoFA reporting are documented
Church-specific help material covers regular collections and payment postings
limitations: It is not a church people database, worship planner, safeguarding system or general communications platform
Public pricing is a starting point rather than a complete church package
The reviewed public pages do not establish current detailed data-processing, hosting, sub-processor or exit arrangements
Churches should obtain appropriate accounting advice for their own reporting and tax position
